defs.def: extremely good; excellent 优秀的；杰出的；出色的

ex.s: The D.C. area is home to many outstanding Chinese restaurants, but diners willing to travel outside the city limits will also be rewarded.
ex.t: 华盛顿特区有许多出色的中餐馆，但愿意走出市区就餐的食客也会有所收获。

ex.s: To honor an outstanding AI expert.
I have never known an outstanding man who lacked either.
ex.t: 我从未见过一个缺乏其中任何一项的杰出人物。

ex.s: Although each year they are fewer in number, their outstanding acts of courage mean that we will always remember them — as well as those who lost their lives on the beaches of northern France.
ex.t: 尽管他们的人数每年都在减少，但他们杰出的英勇行为意味着我们会永远铭记他们——以及那些在法国北部海滩上牺牲的人们。

ex.s: However, what might have made him such an outstanding and creative scientist was probably his strong interest in other things, such as music and drawing.
ex.t: 然而，可能让他成为如此杰出而富有创造力的科学家的，也许是他对其他事物的浓厚兴趣，比如音乐和绘画。

ex.s: They have great facilities and outstanding professors, helping to educate young people who will contribute to the economy and further strengthen our country.
ex.t: 他们拥有一流的设施和杰出的教授，帮助教育那些将为经济做出贡献并进一步巩固我们国家的年轻人。

ex.s: The official title of "World Heritage' Site" is given by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation (UNEscO)committee to places inthe worldthat are outstanding examples of cultural or natural history.
ex.t: ＂世界遗产地＂的官方称号是由联合国教育、科学及文化组织（UNESCO）委员会授予世界上那些是文化或自然历史杰出范例的地方。

defs.def: very obvious or important 突出的；明显的；重要的

ex.s: UNESCO - the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation - maintains a list of sites of outstanding natural importance, so as to protect, conserve and promote awareness of them.
ex.t: 联合国教科文组织——联合国教育、科学及文化组织——维护着一个具有突出自然重要性的地点名录，以保护、保存和提高人们对它们的认识。

defs.def: not yet paid, done, solved, etc. 款项、工作、困难等
